sentences.l2: 现在很多衣服很快就过时了。
sentences.l1: Nowadays many clothes go out of fashion very quickly.

sentences.l2: 人们买很多便宜的衣服，穿几次就不要了。
sentences.l1: People buy a lot of cheap clothes and, after wearing them a few times, no longer want them.

sentences.l2: 这种现象叫“快时尚”。
sentences.l1: This phenomenon is called "fast fashion".

sentences.l2: 快时尚让服装公司生产越来越多的纺织品。
sentences.l1: Fast fashion makes clothing companies produce more and more textiles.

sentences.l2: 生产这些纺织品需要大量的水。
sentences.l1: Producing these textiles requires a large amount of water.

sentences.l2: 例如，做一件棉质T恤可能要用掉两千升水。
sentences.l1: For example, making one cotton T-shirt may use up two thousand liters of water.

sentences.l2: 这会加重全球的水资源短缺问题。
sentences.l1: This will worsen the global problem of water resource shortage.

sentences.l2: 特别是在一些干旱地区，工厂还在大量用水做衣服，让当地居民更难找到足够的水。
sentences.l1: Especially in some arid regions, factories still use large amounts of water to make clothes, making it harder for local residents to find enough water.

sentences.l2: 不仅如此，生产过程中排出的废水常常含有化学物质。
sentences.l1: Not only that, the wastewater discharged during production often contains chemicals.

sentences.l2: 这些废水进入河流和土壤，造成严重的污染。
sentences.l1: This wastewater enters rivers and soil and causes serious pollution.

sentences.l2: 有时候，一条干净的河，流经工业区后就变得又黑又臭。
sentences.l1: Sometimes a clean river becomes black and smelly after flowing through an industrial area.

sentences.l2: 虽然有些公司说他们在改进，但是整个供应链的监管还很弱。
sentences.l1: Although some companies say they are improving, the supervision of the whole supply chain is still weak.

sentences.l2: 很多工厂为了省钱，不处理污水。
sentences.l1: Many factories, in order to save money, do not treat their sewage.

sentences.l2: 快时尚的背后是强烈的消费主义文化。
sentences.l1: Behind fast fashion is a strong culture of consumerism.

sentences.l2: 广告鼓励人们不断购买新的款式。
sentences.l1: Advertisements encourage people to keep buying new styles.

sentences.l2: 社交媒体也让大家觉得旧衣服不好看。
sentences.l1: Social media also makes everyone feel that old clothes do not look good.

sentences.l2: 人们买得越多，浪费就越多。
sentences.l1: The more people buy, the more waste there is.

sentences.l2: 旧衣服大部分不会被回收，而是被烧掉或埋在地下。
sentences.l1: Most old clothes are not recycled, but are burned or buried underground.

sentences.l2: 这不仅浪费资源，还伤害环境。
sentences.l1: This not only wastes resources, but also harms the environment.

sentences.l2: 要解决这个问题，消费者可以买质量好、耐穿的衣服，减少购买次数。
sentences.l1: To solve this problem, consumers can buy good-quality, durable clothes and reduce the number of purchases.

sentences.l2: 一些国家已经开始推动环保法规，要求企业对供应链负责。
sentences.l1: Some countries have already begun to promote environmental protection regulations, requiring companies to be responsible for the supply chain.

sentences.l2: 虽然改变不容易，但每个人都可以从小事做起，减少对水资源的压力。
sentences.l1: Although change is not easy, everyone can start from small things and reduce the pressure on water resources.
